representation_contract.floating_storage_rounding: explicit float16/float32 storage, original dtype restored

interpolation_rule.alignment: no post-hoc alignment; unequal frame/field shapes or voicing masks are not applicable
interpolation_rule.derived_fields: HiFi-Glot normalized pitch and SiFiGAN dilation factors regenerated
interpolation_rule.facodec: continuous decoder-input z and speaker embedding coordinates interpolated linearly
interpolation_rule.fixed_fields: time grid, count, integer and configuration metadata remain unchanged
interpolation_rule.magphase: logF0 interpolation changes pitch-synchronous duration; shifts regenerated
interpolation_rule.phase: LLSM removes endpoint F0 phase integration, interpolates residual phases by shortest arc, then integrates interpolated F0; GOLF phase is frequency increment
interpolation_rule.positive_amplitude_power: log interpolation when both positive; linear at an exact zero boundary
interpolation_rule.primary_pitch: linear in log Hz with unchanged voicing mask
interpolation_rule.scope: same utterance reencoded at original and -6 dB input; existing +3 semitone endpoint is an optional separate condition

missing_native_controls: time-only: pitch-synchronous shifts are not an independent duration control
quantization_exclusions: MagPhase analysis frame shifts and categorical UV sentinel

adapter_info.variant: MagPhase2 compressed100/45/45 pitch-synchronous; SPTK3.9+REAPER; Python3 compatibility patch

data.analysis_reuse: one encode, then independent parameter edits

gain_minus6.description: add dB * ln(10) / 20 to every compressed log-magnitude bin

gain_plus6.description: add dB * ln(10) / 20 to every compressed log-magnitude bin

pitch_minus3.description: add semitone * ln(2)/12 to voiced log-F0; pitch-synchronous timing also changes

pitch_plus3.description: add semitone * ln(2)/12 to voiced log-F0; pitch-synchronous timing also changes

data.native_payload_storage: HNM/WORLD existing module.save container; other six numeric tree NPZ. All eight formal decodes use actual saved-and-reloaded inputs. Derived payloads use numeric tree NPZ.

prepared.note: 上流コードと重みをキャッシュへ取得。第三者コードを本リポジトリに複製しない。

data.randomness: seed before encode; reset to the same explicit seed immediately before every unedited/edited decode

timing_definition.native_comparison: Only the predeclared single-worker native phase; shared-host timing remains descriptive.
